S.FORM: Tayal qalang hogal squnun kuwara squliq na tayal Taywan ga kbhul hi ga sazing pasento balay. kya hmzinas smka na' qu cyux maki qalang rgyax, kya obeh smka squliq tayal cyux mshzi maki qalang hogal la. cingay qu pcyuwagan qalang hogal hya, smrawiy hmuluy khmay mrkyas. kruma ga cyux si trhuw maki qalang hogal, mtzyuwaw, magal bes, ru qmayat kinbahan. nanu yasa qu cingay balay kinbahan tayal cyux mrkyas mqyanux qalang hogal la.
S.PHON: tajal qalaŋ ħoɣal [s|ɕ]qunun kuwara [s|ɕ]quliq na tajal tajwan ɣa kβħul ħi ɣa [s|ɕ]aziŋ pa[s|ɕ]ento βalaj kja ħmzina[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]mka naʔ qu [ʦ|ʨ]jux maki qalaŋ rɣjax kja oβeħ [s|ɕ]mka [s|ɕ]quliq tajal [ʦ|ʨ]jux m[s|ɕ]ħzi maki qalaŋ ħoɣal la [ʦ|ʨ]iŋaj qu p[ʦ|ʨ]juwaɣan qalaŋ ħoɣal ħja [s|ɕ]mrawij ħmuluj kħmaj mrkja[s|ɕ] kruma ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]jux [s|ɕ]i trħuw maki qalaŋ ħoɣal mtzjuwaw maɣal βe[s|ɕ] ru qmajat kinβaħan nanu ja[s|ɕ]a qu [ʦ|ʨ]iŋaj βalaj kinβaħan tajal [ʦ|ʨ]jux mrkja[s|ɕ] mqjanux qalaŋ ħoɣal la
